create_conversation_sample: create a conversation dict with user prompt, assistant tool_calls, and tool schemas from a raw dataset sample
run_sft_train_aya_tool_calling: run supervised fine-tuning on CohereLabs/tiny-aya-global with QLoRA to teach tool calling using the SimpleToolCalling dataset
build_tool_schemas: build tool schema definitions for search_knowledge_base and search_google functions with parameter specs
train_model_with_lora: train a causal language model with LoRA and 4-bit quantization using SFTTrainer on tool-calling conversations
configure_sft_training: configure SFT training with a custom Jinja2 chat template that serializes tool schemas into the system preamble
